overall_goal: Assemble the food processor and use it to crush multiple batches of biscuits.

goals.description: Gather ingredients and prepare food processor parts.
goals.rationale: The person gathers the biscuits and begins unpacking the food processor parts to prepare for crushing.

goals.description: Attempt to assemble the food processor blade.
goals.rationale: The person tries multiple times to fit the blade into the food processor using incorrect pieces.

goals.description: Find the correct piece and figure out the assembly.
goals.rationale: The person locates the missing center piece and successfully figures out how it attaches to the blade.

goals.description: Wash and dry the center piece of the food processor.
goals.rationale: The person washes the newly found center piece with a sponge and dries it thoroughly with a towel before use.

goals.description: Assemble the food processor blade and plug in the appliance.
goals.rationale: The person attaches the clean center piece to the blade, inserts it into the bowl, and plugs the food processor into the socket.

goals.description: Test the food processor and prepare it for use.
goals.rationale: The person closes the lid to test if the food processor turns on, then opens it again to prepare for adding ingredients.

goals.description: Add the first batch of biscuits to the food processor.
goals.rationale: The person opens a packet of biscuits, pours a portion into the food processor bowl, and closes the lid.

goals.description: Crush the first batch of biscuits.
goals.rationale: The person runs the food processor to crush the biscuits, checking the consistency and running it again.

goals.description: Add more biscuits to the food processor.
goals.rationale: The person opens the lid, adds handfuls of biscuits from the opened packet, and closes the lid again.

goals.description: Crush the second batch of biscuits.
goals.rationale: The person turns on the food processor to grind the newly added biscuits, checking to ensure they are finely crushed.

goals.description: Add the remaining biscuits from the first packet and crush them.
goals.rationale: The person empties the rest of the first biscuit packet into the bowl and runs the food processor at varying speeds to crush them.

goals.description: Add a second packet of biscuits to the food processor.
goals.rationale: The person opens a new packet of biscuits, pours them into the bowl, and discards a dropped biscuit into the bin.

goals.description: Crush the second packet of biscuits.
goals.rationale: The person runs the food processor again, adjusting the speed to ensure the newly added biscuits are finely ground.
